relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: From the age of nine, his father, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, taught him meditation, passing on to him the most essential instructions of the Dzogchen and Mahamudra traditions.

relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the age of eleven, Mingyur Rinpoche began studies at Sherab Ling Monastery in northern India

relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the age of nineteen, he enrolled at Dzongsar Institute

relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: under the tutelage of the renowned Khenpo Kunga Wangchuk, he studied the primary topics of the Buddhist academic tradition, including Middle Way philosophy and Buddhist logic.

relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At age twenty, Mingyur Rinpoche became the functioning abbot of Sherab Ling.

relations.subject: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
relations.evidence: During this time, Mingyur Rinpoche received important Dzogchen transmissions from Nyoshul Khen Rinpoche.
